one_sentence_fix: Remake 08's focal grains as one buff quartz albedo with fine variance, translucency and lower-amplitude sub-angular displacement, and carry 06's shaded stipple wall through its lower third feathered per text line, never a rectangle.

artwork_weakest_detail.fix: one buff albedo family with fine per-grain variance, transmission 0.15 to 0.25 with thickness, half the displacement amplitude at lower frequency for sub-angular faces, cushion-blue fog in the pore throat
carry the shaded stipple wall and ring joints through the lower third, feathered per text line by signed distance, never a rectangle; light the lower arc of the near collar
dotted strata contacts to about 45 percent ink with a faint lit ghost at each contact plane
a 1 px lit upper edge on each weld course; a back-wall ellipse and refractive edge strip on the glass vessel

editor_notes_for_email: Raw 8.52 against the round 4 threshold 7.7; normalised 7.745 still clears. Shortfall against the base 8.3 flagged per the ladder.
Cover says 'backed'; the finding is preliminary (02 and 09 carry it). In replies say 'favors'.
08 joins the October 7th letter (C56) to the Pioneer Law opinion (C57) as Alaska Public Media relays them; neither was fetched.
Thin AI content by design; expect 'where's the AI' replies.
scorer: scorer subagent, second scoring after the craft cycle, artwork re-judged with 06 reverted

craft_cycle.note: 06 reverted to its pre-cycle version after the cycle's version added a visible text box (critic 7.9 vs 8.4); the scorer re-judged artwork at 7.5 with the revert
